review_method: Evaluator-custody review of every selected-source parent/target diff. Admission requires an observable causal repair slice matching the frozen edit stratum. A broad public PR may supply context, but only the named slice may define the natural request and evaluator; unrelated target changes cannot become answer templates, hidden requirements, or acceptance conditions.

causal_slices.mechanism: Read a legacy manifest size through a missing-key fallback rather than unconditional indexing.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: A legacy row without size_bytes must be handled while an explicit size_bytes value remains unchanged.

causal_slices.mechanism: Preserve requested feature-column ordering through name-based selection and stable duplicate removal.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Reordered and duplicated feature requests must produce the requested stable column order without changing distinct values.

causal_slices.mechanism: Replace nested parameter indexing with a chained mapping fallback for devices lacking a parameter definition.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: A missing device mapping must fall back to the parameter code while a present mapping retains its exact code.

causal_slices.mechanism: Distinguish an omitted path from an explicitly supplied empty path with an identity predicate.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: None and an empty path-like value must take different declared branches without truthiness laundering.

causal_slices.mechanism: Enforce fill-color and fill-pattern mutual exclusion in both update directions.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Setting either fill mode must remove the conflicting mode while unrelated style fields remain stable.

causal_slices.mechanism: Resolve F2Py kind requirements through corrected predicate and kind-mapping logic.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Mapped and unmapped kind requirements must take the correct branch without accepting a mismatched typedef.

causal_slices.mechanism: Apply the repaired genomic range ordering rule to the collection while preserving associated row data.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Adversarial chromosome/strand ordering must be correct and every non-key value must remain attached to its original row.

causal_slices.mechanism: Detect serpentine sweeps using offset-invariant deltas rather than absolute high-offset values.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Equivalent low- and high-offset sweeps must yield the same orientation and non-serpentine data must remain unchanged.

causal_slices.mechanism: Split ingest output so every emitted chunk respects the configured maximum size.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Oversized boundary cases must be fully covered by bounded chunks with no loss, duplication, or empty trailing fragment.

causal_slices.mechanism: Honor an active forced-offline window before ordinary environment checks and network reachability work.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: An active force-offline state must return offline without a reachability call; inactive state must preserve normal environment behavior.

causal_slices.mechanism: Move the optional Tavily import into the fallback call and guard ImportError before client construction.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Module import must succeed without Tavily, fallback use must raise the declared local error, and installed Tavily behavior must remain callable.

causal_slices.mechanism: Remove a leading duplicate H1 before downstream challenge-description conversion.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: A duplicated leading title must collapse once while distinct headings and title-free content remain unchanged.

causal_slices.mechanism: Convert a message-not-found management response into an empty session collection after the request completes.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: The exact not-found response must return an empty list while success and unrelated error responses retain their prior behavior.

causal_slices.mechanism: Inspect noninteractive clone completion and return a bounded failure after a nonzero result.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: A failed clone must not yield a source reference or hang for credentials; a successful clone must preserve the existing return path.

causal_slices.mechanism: Insert refreshed S3 Express credentials into a bounded ordered cache and evict the oldest entry after overflow.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Concurrent same-bucket refresh must deduplicate, cache hits must move to the end, overflow must evict exactly the oldest entry, and failures must not poison the cache.

causal_slices.mechanism: Add a coordinate-normalization unit and route locator consumers through it so logical and physical display spaces agree.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: The helper and consumer must agree under non-unit scaling, round-trip coordinates within tolerance, and preserve unit-scale behavior.

causal_slices.mechanism: Add dependency-aware definition ordering and integrate it into the sorter without moving a definition below import-time reads.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: A dependency chain and cycle control must preserve import-time availability, deterministic ordering, and source content.

causal_slices.mechanism: Centralize the instrument-type allowlist and consume it at database-write validation sites.
causal_slices.evaluator_obligation: Both configuration and writer paths must accept the same allowed set, reject an unknown type, and avoid divergent duplicate constants.

maximum_inference: All 18 selected-source pairs contain a scopeable causal repair matching the frozen edit stratum, so evaluator construction and independent parent-negative/target-positive qualification may begin. This does not establish that any evaluator is adequate, that the implementation or model can solve a task, that Semantic-IR has a treatment effect, or that D1, D2, training, serving, or book support may open.
